capture_procedure: Hidden editor viewport, 1280x720, SDR display-referred PNG; not Movie Render Queue and not a linear EXR.

rect_light.light_color_note: The Python light_color property returns FColor 0-255; the authored light color is white.

exposure.effective_method: histogram metering pinned to EV100 4 by min=max=4 and bias=0; not manual mode

wording_corrections: Exposure is histogram AEM_HISTOGRAM pinned by min_brightness == max_brightness == EV100 4; it is not manual exposure mode.
Draw request counts are not path-tracer sample counts. The engine path-tracing sample index proves 256 and 1024 samples; 256 samples accumulated across about 86 draw requests.
The 8-bounce truncation and the unoverridden engine path-intensity clamp (PathTracing.MaxPathIntensity 24.0) can bias the path-traced reference; it is a finite reference, not ground truth.
The SDR PNG is display-referred 8-bit output, not a linear EXR and not a transport-error metric.
limitations: Editor viewport capture, not Movie Render Queue or a packaged build.
The editor viewport is SDR (GetSceneHDREnabled false), so the capture path writes display-referred 8-bit PNG; no linear EXR is produced by this procedure.

Path-tracer sample accumulation is not one sample per viewport draw: 256 samples accumulated across about 86 explicit draw requests (sample reset/first sample at draw 357, nonzero progression from draw 358, capture draw 443). The engine GetPathTracingSampleIndex() is authoritative; this is not a timing or performance benchmark.
Lumen screen-probe/radiosity temporal state is warmed but not proven converged; stochastic noise is expected.
The saved room keeps its recorded RectLight attenuation radius (1000 cm), even though the original builder requested 2000 cm.
Path tracing was rendered through the editor viewport on one GPU; multi-GPU and Movie Render Queue were not used.
The RTPSO fallback warning appears once during the discarded warm-up; no fallback was logged after the forced reset.
The engine NNEDenoiser plugin was instantiated by the project defaults, but r.PathTracing.Denoiser 0 prevented use of a denoise pass.
The 256 spp image still contains Monte Carlo noise; no convergence metric or performance benchmark is claimed.
The published original Lumen image is used only as a cross-check of room, camera and capture procedure.
